name: Great Migration & Plains Safari
summary: Follow wildebeest columns, predator action and golden Serengeti light – timed for calving or river-crossing seasons when you travel.
overview: Tanzania’s Serengeti ecosystem defines the African safari imagination. We plan migration safaris around where herds are likely to be – Ndutu calving flats, central Serengeti or northern river lines – with unhurried game drives and small groups (max six per vehicle).

seo.title: Great Migration Safaris Tanzania | Endemic Birds
seo.description: Serengeti migration safaris – calving season and plains wildlife with small-group guides.

name: Ngorongoro & Northern Icons
summary: Crater floor drama, Tarangire elephants, Manyara forest lakes and Arusha’s Momella – the classic northern circuit without the rush.
overview: The northern circuit packs UNESCO-calibre scenery and dense wildlife into a week or less. We sequence drives for crater descent timing, river-line elephants in Tarangire and lake viewpoints at Manyara – always with window seats and adaptable pacing.

seo.title: Northern Circuit Wildlife Safaris | Endemic Birds
seo.description: Ngorongoro, Tarangire, Manyara and Serengeti wildlife safaris with specialist guides.

name: Chimps & Lake Forests
summary: Track chimpanzees in Mahale and Gombe, then unwind on Lake Tanganyika – forest mornings and beach afternoons.
overview: Western Tanzania delivers primate encounters that feel worlds away from the busier north. Chimp treks are on foot with park rangers; we build in lake time, boat transfers and comfortable pacing for repeat photographers and first-time Africa travellers alike.

seo.title: Chimpanzee Safaris Tanzania | Endemic Birds
seo.description: Mahale and western Tanzania chimp tracking safaris with Endemic Birds.

name: Southern & Western Wilderness
summary: Ruaha’s baobab wilds, Mikumi savanna, Nyerere’s Rufiji boats and Katavi hippo seas – remote circuits for repeat safari travellers.
overview: When you want distance from crowds, southern and western parks reward with river systems, miombo hills and raw predator-prey dynamics. We combine flight or road links with realistic drive days so you arrive fresh for morning game drives.

seo.title: Southern Tanzania Wildlife Safaris | Endemic Birds
seo.description: Ruaha, Nyerere, Mikumi and Katavi wilderness safaris – remote Tanzania wildlife.

name: Bush, Beach & Luxury Flying
summary: Pair classic wildlife with Zanzibar stone-town and spice-island coast – or hop camps by light aircraft across the country.
overview: These journeys suit honeymoons, celebrations and travellers who want both big-game time and Indian Ocean recovery. Flying safaris cut long road days; bush-and-beach routes hand off cleanly from savanna to sea.

seo.title: Luxury & Bush-Beach Safaris Tanzania | Endemic Birds
seo.description: Flying safaris and bush-to-beach Tanzania wildlife holidays with Endemic Birds.
